verdict.rationale: Gecko's documented capability is AI-driven source-code vulnerability scanning (source-to-sink analysis, PR patches, ticketing) for application repositories, not scanning container images for OS-package or application-layer CVEs prior to deployment. No evidence pack item mentions image layer scanning, base-image CVE databases, or Docker/OCI artifact scanning — the closest item (docs-14, digest-pinned image_ref) refers to resolving a scanner's own release version, not scanning customer container images. Missing for 10: any documented container/image scanning feature, OS-package vulnerability database integration, or CI step for scanning built images before deploy.
